pr_metadata.title: clip: terminate processes in clip() instead of in main()
pr_metadata.description:
clip() in clip/run.py used to not terminate the processes it started except in main()

this allows other programs to directly call clip

gold_comments.issue_summary:
let's make a little helper (and put it in `common/`) to do this in a context manager:
```python
with Proc('./replay'), proc('./ui')...:
	<code>
```
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added code uses a try/finally block to terminate processes manually instead of using a context manager helper as suggested by the reviewer.
gold_comments.rationale: A context manager would encapsulate process lifecycle management, improving robustness and readability; the current implementation duplicates cleanup logic and is more error-prone.
